title: Jagged Crispy Vietnamese Chocolate Cha Gio
description: A monsoon-inspired twist on traditional Vietnamese spring rolls, featuring crispy rice noodles, savory meat, and a rich chocolate glaze.

ingredients.name: Ground pork
ingredients.notes: you can also use ground beef or a combination of the two

ingredients.name: Chocolate chips
ingredients.notes: at least 70% cocoa, chopped into small pieces

instructions: Heat the oil in a deep frying pan to 180°C for frying the cha gio.
Cut the rice noodles into shorter lengths and set aside.
In a large mixing bowl, combine the ground pork, egg, salt, and pepper. Mix well until just combined.
Divide the pork mixture among the rice noodle sheets, placing a tablespoon or two in the center of each sheet.
Cook pork to an internal temperature of 63°C / 145°F and let it rest for 3 minutes before serving.
Cook ground beef to an internal temperature of 71°C / 160°F (no longer pink in the middle) before serving.
